title: System Monitor widget's Load Preset menu is tiny
line: The System Monitor widget's Load Preset dialog now shows every preset at the default settings window size.
explanation: The Load Preset Kirigami.Dialog is declared inside the appearance FormLayout, so that short form became its parent. Kirigami limits a dialog to its parent's size, so in the default-size window (where the form is only about four rows tall) the list showed three rows with truncated names, and it grew when the window was narrowed and the form wrapped. The dialog is now parented to the window's overlay, so it is sized and centred against the whole settings window.

commits.message:
faces: Size the Load Preset dialog to the window

The Load Preset dialog was a child of the short appearance form, and
Kirigami caps a dialog at its parent's size, so it showed three rows in
a big window. Parent it to the window overlay so it can use the window.

BUG: 517100

patches.diff:
From ffaf517829f7d4e84a02b7c67966fc6b8dff9639 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:18:39 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] faces: Size the Load Preset dialog to the window

The Load Preset dialog was a child of the short appearance form, and
Kirigami caps a dialog at its parent's size, so it showed three rows in
a big window. Parent it to the window overlay so it can use the window.

BUG: 517100
---
 faces/ConfigAppearance.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/faces/ConfigAppearance.qml b/faces/ConfigAppearance.qml
index f32840db..b883c3c0 100644
--- a/faces/ConfigAppearance.qml
+++ b/faces/ConfigAppearance.qml
@@ -67,6 +67,7 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
 
     Kirigami.Dialog {
         id: presetDialog
+        parent: QQC2.Overlay.overlay
         modal: true
 
         title: i18nd("KSysGuardSensorFaces", "Load Preset")
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Default-size settings window: Load Preset shows three rows, 'Individual Core ...' cut off, with a scrollbar
Same window with the fix: all six presets visible, centred in the window

review.text: Clean one-line fix that addresses the root cause of the regression introduced when the preset picker moved to Kirigami.Dialog inside Kirigami.FormLayout. Parenting presetDialog to QQC2.Overlay.overlay follows the standard Qt Quick Controls / Kirigami idiom so the dialog sizes and centers against the whole settings window instead of the short form layout. Before/after screenshots and regression checks convincingly verify the fix.
